title: Singular Forces on the Whole Space: Sobolev Density Thresholds and Energy Approximation
summary: We derive whole-space distribution results from the established compact, smoothly forced Navier--Stokes blowup construction of OpenAI. For every fixed positive viscosity and deadline, smooth forces causing classical breakdown from rest on $\mathbb R^3$ are dense in the relative $L^1_tH^s_x$ topology exactly when $s<1/2$, and in the relative $L^2_tH^s_x$ topology exactly when $s<-1/2$. The positive results preserve every fixed initial velocity in $H^\infty_σ(\R^3)$.
